requiredbulletpoints.bulletpoint: Founder and principal engineer of Grey Skies Automation, an independent robotics lab designing competitive combat robots, custom PCBs with embedded firmware, telemetry systems, and boutique hardware/software tools.
Awarded NHRL 'Most Innovative Bot' for Injection!, pioneering real-time haptic driver feedback based on damage, battery state, and live telemetry.

bulletpoints.bulletpoint: Developed Two Factor Annihilation with Steam Deck-based telemetry and control visualization, achieving 2nd place at its debut while demonstrating real-time monitoring and driver feedback.
Implemented adaptive control systems adjusting driver feedback based on live sensor data (damage state, battery metrics), introducing semi-autonomous assist behavior in competition.
Built a Steam Deck telemetry interface with real-time 3D orientation and audio impact feedback, earning feature coverage in robotics media such as NHRL.
Designed and sold a custom ESC programming breakout board (PCB hardware), simplifying configuration for combat robotics teams and generating ~$2,000 through iterative revisions.
Operated Grey Skies Automation delivering custom robotics electronics, music-tech prototypes, and consulting engagements (including HowellXR projects).
Developed embedded firmware for combat robotics platforms, integrating sensor data, telemetry transmission, and adaptive control logic for live decision support.
